x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: For each department: 1. Service owner, groups (fulfilment + approvers), roles 2. Services list → catalogue category + items/record producers (shared variable sets) 3. Target table: OOB department app if licensed; else agreed shared request/case table 4. Flows: approvals and tasks from the reusable subflow 5. SLAs and schedules 6. Knowledge base and Employee Center taxonomy topic 7. Notifications and survey 8. Dashboard filtered to the department 9. ATF: routing + negative access test 10. Update set ESM_<department>_<client>_v1; go-live comms
